text:
jen: Quick alert — planned deploy window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. Need coordination across API, runtime, console, router. Can everyone ack?
sam: ack, I'll own API schema pin and rollout flags.
leo: ack, router team here — planning a staged rollout across shards, will need pin window.
maria: console ack, will hold UI feature flag until runtime verifies model handshake.
jen: deploy-bot, preflight for target services? want a soft pin on runtime and API versions to avoid accidental roll-forward.
deploy-bot: preflight check triggered by jen at 2024-06-25T00:00Z.
deploy-bot: Checks: infra health OK, <= 2% error rate on runtime, router cluster capacity 120% buffer, API RATELIMIT quotas green.
leo: router note — will apply traffic-splitting 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% in 20m increments. If latency > 120ms for 3 consecutive windows, automatic rollback.
sam: API plan: pin /v2/generate to model v2.8.1 for this window. Newer v2.9 has charset change; we'll avoid until console tests pass.
maria: Console will run smoke tests against pinned API v2.8.1, then toggle feature flag. Test harness command:```bash
./ci/run_smoke.sh --env=staging --api-version=v2.8.1
```
jen: runtime: do we have a compat kernel for v2.8.1 quantized builds? Also need KV cache eviction policy set to 48h for canary.
leo: runtime (leo): yes, kernel-compat v2.8 is on all nodes in eu/us. KV eviction change is set via config map; we'll patch at T-15m.
jen: ops, schedule a temporary release-cordon on infra to avoid unrelated deploys creeping in during the window.
ops: scheduled: release-cordon applied 00:15-01:45 UTC. Noted.
sam: will post release notes snippet to engineering-changelog after successful rollout. Snippet: "Pin API /v2/generate -> v2.8.1 to avoid stripe-of-life regression; router staged rollout; console gated behind smoke tests."
jen: rollback criteria roundup: - API 5xx rate >1% sustained for 10m - runtime token error rate spike >0.5% - console smoke tests fail on >=2 checks - router p50 latency >120ms for 3 windows. If triggered, immediate rollback to previous pinned versions.
leo: adding router-specific fallback: if canary fails, we re-route canary traffic back to baseline and block promotion. Manual approval required for retry.
maria: note on release notes: include note about KV cache change and eviction, could impact long-running sessions.
sam: deploy-bot, can you create pinning entry and attach the release-cordon label?
deploy-bot: pin created: api:/v2/generate@v2.8.1, runtime@v2.8.0-quant, router-canary-split=5%. Labels: [release-cordon, soft-pin].
jen: thanks. T-30m checklist: - confirm smoke test fixtures refreshed (maria) - confirm kernel-compat on all runtime nodes (leo) - ensure observability dashboards have 5m and 1m alerts (ops)
maria: fixtures refreshed.
leo: kernel-compat confirmed on 98% nodes, draining 2 nodes for patch; will be back by T-12m.
ops: dashboards updated and alert runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-window
jen: launch plan: at 00:30 deploy-bot will start canary wave. Manual pause at 00:50 to review metrics. If green, proceed to 25% at 01:10 and full at 01:30.
sam: release notes draft added to PR, will link once deploy completes.
leo: small router tweak: adding hedged read timeout to 200ms for this window to reduce head-tail latency during canary.
jen: last call for other blockers?
sam: none from API.
maria: none from console.
leo: minor: monitor shard-7 closely — it had a noisy neighbor last week.
jen: ok. After action: if everything green by 01:40, we'll remove soft-pin and update release notes to mark GA. If not, leave pin and open follow-up.
deploy-bot: scheduled actions: T+0 start canary 5% at 00:30, T+20 increase to 25% at 00:50 pending manual confirm, T+60 promote to 100% at 01:30. Auto-rollback triggers configured per criteria.
ops: applying final cordon check.
jen: thanks all. We'll reconvene in-thread at 00:45 for the manual check. :thumbsup:
